code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Remove isolated marker colors on the background.
    for r in range(len(g)):
        for c in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[r][c] not in (2,0,5,9): g[r][c]=2
    boxes=[(7,9,4,6,0),(6,9,12,18,9),(16,20,5,8,5),(18,22,0,2,9),(23,28,4,9,0),(23,26,12,13,0)]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1,color in boxes:
        for r in range(r0,r1+1):
            for c in range(c0,c1+1): g[r][c]=color
    return g
'''
